body.en: Sereniel's Afterglow, Tenacity Damage and Homing Lazers

Afterglow is Serenial's Unique Buff
Next Attack Card: +1 Tenacity Damage and +50% Dmg on Ravaged Enemies
Afterglow is consumed on every attack card that uses it, no limit of stacks
Tenacity Damage is another way of Damaging Tenacity
1 Tenacity Damage is equal to 1 Bar of Tenacity
Weakness does not change the ammount of Tenacity Damage
Homing Lazers are Serenial's main pay off for Ravage
They Move themself into hand on Ravage to be used again

text.en: 180% Damage. 1 Tenacity Damage. If the target is not Ravaged, proc 1 more time.
180% Damage. 3 Afterglow. On Ravage, move to hand.

body.en:
Tenacity is the Bar Underneath some enemies
Tenacity is broken up into Segments, different on each enemy
Not all Enemies have Tenacity Bars to be Ravage
Tenacity is decreased by Attack cards in different ammounts
Examples:
2 Cost Attack against Weakness = 2 Full Bars of Tenacity
1 Cost Attack against Weakness = 1 Full Bar of Tenacity
0 Cost Attack against Weakness = 1/2 Bar of Tenacity
If the enemy is not weak, characters do 1/3rd of the usual damage to Tenacity
Non Targeted Attacks deal 1/2 of the usual damage to Tenacity
Ravage is the state an enemy enters if their Tenacity is Broken
Ravaging an enemy grants the team +1 AP and delays enemy action count +1
Characters unless they specifically have an Anti Ravage effects
Do not deal extra damage to enemies that are Ravaged
